FAQ

Answers you'll likely want

Everything you need to know about running voice and text bookings, escrow payouts, and municipal pilots inside WhatsApp.

Need a custom pilot or integration?

Reach our deployment team directly or launch a pilot in under 48 hours.

Does it work without installing an app?+
Yes. Everything runs inside WhatsApp. We optimize for tiny payloads and low-bandwidth flows.
Which languages are supported?+
English, Shona, and Ndebele in voice or text. More on the roadmap.
How do payments work?+
Jobs are secured via escrow. On completion, funds are released and receipts are issued automatically.
Can you integrate with our tools?+
Yes. Enterprise plans include custom integrations and SLAs.
